spanish: y despoja a Aarón de sus vestidos, y hazlos vestir a Elazar su hijo; y Aarón será reunido, y morirá allí.

findings.issue: Hiphil 2ms with a 3mp suffix clothes Eleazar with the garments; «hazlos vestir a Elazar» makes that plural the agent that dresses Eleazar.

notes: Strip Aaron of his garments, Aaron gathered, and die there match the tokens.
